title: Rosette Nebula
notes: Three nights combined. Every frame was checked, and 346 hit by cloud or the dawn sky were left out. The Seestar's alt-az mount lets the field rotate during the night, so the three nights were aligned and trimmed to the area they share. The light-pollution gradient was removed, and the hydrogen and oxygen signals mapped to gold and blue, with gentle sharpening.
quote: You've definitely brought out more of the fainter features.

title: Crescent Nebula
notes: The corner stars were comet-shaped (coma and a touch of tilt) and left coloured shadows, so their shapes were corrected before the colour work, and the oxygen frames, up to 1.1 px out in the corners, were realigned. Flats from another night still cleaned up the dust and vignetting. Finished in the Hubble palette with a gold lift where hydrogen leads.

title: Dolphin Nebula
integration: Hα 30 × 120 s, OIII 54 × 120 s used, 2.8 h
notes: Eleven hydrogen frames caught a red glow from stray light in one corner and were left out, and the crop keeps clear of that corner. With hydrogen and oxygen only, hydrogen stands in for sulphur in the palette, and the finish is kept soft so the faint wisps stay smooth.
quote: The images look really good, well done!

title: Bubble Nebula
scope: StellaLyra 8-inch Newtonian at 1,868 mm, ZWO ASI1600MM Pro
integration: 94 × 60 s in each filter, 3.1 h (hazy frames down-weighted or dropped)
notes: The bright star below the Bubble had a wide halo in the oxygen frames only: a reflection in the filter, not nebula, so it was removed and the uneven oxygen background flattened. With no flats, a glow along one edge is cropped away.
quote: You're pulling some wonderful detail out of these data sets! Well done.

title: Elephant's Trunk
notes: No flats came with this set, so flats from a later session with the same scope and camera were used. The data came out faint and flat, so it has a stronger finish than usual, with the shadows lifted so the dark nebula keeps its detail. A coloured fringe along one edge is cropped away.
